app.title: Migration Analysis Dashboard
app.summary: A person picks one of two bundled tracking datasets (GPS location fixes or accelerometer bursts) and chooses one tagged individual from the sidebar. For a location-tracked animal, they read its summary figures: days tracked, total distance, start and end dates, and average daily distance. They then follow its route on a map, see the distance it covered each day, see a correlation heatmap of two habitat covariates, and see how many fixes fall in each hour of the day. For an accelerometer-tagged animal, they pick one burst and see its three-axis trace and its movement intensity, see how measurements are spread across the hours of the day, and can show the distribution of intensity across every burst.

task.text: Summarize how one tagged animal moved, from its location fixes or its accelerometer bursts: route, distance per day, and activity by hour.

data.text: Animal-borne tag records, one row per timestamped record and individual: either GPS fixes with latitude, longitude and habitat covariates, or raw three-axis accelerometer bursts stored as space-separated values.
data.item: one tagged individual's series of timestamped location fixes or acceleration bursts

stage.text: exploring animal tracking data after tag retrieval, before movement analysis

mechanism.text: A sidebar radio switches between the location dataset and the accelerometer dataset, and a dropdown picks one individual. Every metric, map and chart below then redraws for that individual. In accelerometer mode, a second dropdown picks one burst for the trace and intensity plots, and a checkbox shows a histogram of intensity across all bursts.

field.text: GPS telemetry and accelerometry of tagged animals in movement ecology

workflow.name: summarize one tracked individual's movement from its tag records

steps.here: Two bundled CSVs load at startup and are cached. Timestamps are split into date, month and hour, and each raw acceleration string is parsed into x, y, z columns.

steps.step: pick the dataset and one individual to look at
steps.here: A 'Select Dataset' radio chooses between bird migration and bat activity, then a 'Select Bird ID' or 'Select Bat ID' dropdown picks one individual.

steps.step: compute a value from the data
steps.here: Metric tiles show days tracked, total great-circle distance between consecutive fixes, start and end dates, average km/day and the tag ID, or for accelerometer data the recording span and measurement count.
A zoomable map, centred on the individual's mean position, draws line segments between consecutive fixes.

steps.step: break movement down by day and by hour
steps.here: A line chart shows the km covered each calendar day. Bar charts count fixes or measurements per hour of the day, and a heatmap shows the correlation between two vegetation-cover covariates.
A 'Select Timestamp for Detailed Analysis' dropdown picks one burst. Its X/Y/Z trace and its vector-magnitude intensity are plotted side by side.

steps.step: summarize the distribution across all items
steps.here: Ticking 'Show Movement Statistics' pools the intensity of every burst for the individual into a 50-bin histogram.

distinctive: Distances are great-circle (haversine) distances summed between consecutive GPS fixes, both over the whole track and within each calendar day.
Two kinds of tag data share one dashboard: location fixes for one taxon and raw tri-axial accelerometer bursts for another, switched by a radio.
Raw accelerometer bursts arrive as one space-separated string per record and are split into interleaved x, y, z samples. Intensity is the per-sample vector magnitude.
Activity by time of day is read as how many records fall in each hour.

parts.title: Dataset and individual selector
parts.summary: Loads both tracking datasets, then chooses which one to view and which tagged individual every view below shows.

parts.title: Bird migration analysis
parts.summary: The location-tracking page for the selected individual. Besides the components inside it, it draws a correlation heatmap of two habitat covariates and a bar chart of fixes per hour of the day.

parts.title: Individual summary metrics
parts.summary: Shows days tracked, total distance, start and end dates, average daily distance and tag ID for the selected individual.

parts.title: Migration route map
parts.summary: Draws the individual's track as line segments between consecutive fixes on a zoomable map.

parts.title: Daily distance traveled
parts.summary: Sums the haversine distance between consecutive fixes within each calendar day and plots km per day as a line chart.

parts.title: Bat acceleration analysis
parts.summary: The accelerometer page for the selected individual. It shows the recording span and measurement count, and a bar chart of measurements per hour of the day.

parts.title: Acceleration burst detail
parts.summary: Picks one timestamped burst and plots its X, Y, Z acceleration trace beside its vector-magnitude movement intensity.

parts.title: Movement intensity distribution
parts.summary: Shown on request, it pools the intensity of every burst for the individual into a histogram.
